description: Identifies the project platform based on task tags in Runrun.it (Node, Python, Ruby, Go, Rust, etc.) and suggests the command to upload the development environment. The platform is defined by task tags (tags_data/tag_list), not by repository files.

task_id.description: ID da task no Runrun.it. As tags dessa task definem a plataforma (ex.: node, react, python).

name: runrunit_project_detect_platform
